title: Derive renormalized free energy coefficients for [111] epitaxial film
action: Assemble the bulk Landau coefficients, elastic compliances, and electrostrictive constants for PbTiO3 from Haun et al. (1987). Perform the coordinate rotation to the [1-10]/[11-2]/[111] frame and the Legendre transformation incorporating the fixed in-plane biaxial misfit strain u_m' = -0.013 and a variable out-of-plane stress σ3'. Compute the renormalized free energy coefficients a1*, a11*, a12*, A12, A123, A1223, B, C that define the thermodynamic potential F(P1,P2,P3) used in the minimization step. Save the coefficient set for later use.
description: This step derives the parameters that define the free energy functional for the stressed [111] epitaxial film. Without these correct renormalized coefficients the subsequent minimization cannot yield the paper's equilibrium states.
output_schema: {"coefficients": {"a1_star": float, "a11_star": float, "a12_star": float, "A12": float, "A123": float, "A1223": float, "B": float, "C": float}} (optional evidence object)

title: Minimize free energy and compute properties at specified stress points
action: Using the derived renormalized coefficients, for at least the out-of-plane compressive stress values σ3' = -3.535, -3.56, -4.36, -4.565, and -4.65 GPa, numerically minimize F(P1,P2,P3) to find stable equilibrium polarization states. For each stress point, compute the out-of-plane lattice strain S3' and monoclinic shear strain S4' via the electrostrictive relations, and the out-of-plane dielectric constant ε33' and piezoelectric coefficient d33' from the free energy Hessian. Write the complete results to the output file.
description: This is the core reproduction artifact. It contains the equilibrium polarization, strain, and response properties for the specified stress points. The values are compared to hidden reference values and structural trends are verified.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: "stress_points" (list of float in GPa), "results" (list of objects, each with keys "P1", "P2", "P3" (float C/m^2), "S3" (float, dimensionless), "S4" (float, dimensionless), "d33" (float pm/V), "epsilon33" (float dimensionless), in the same order as the stress points).
